text: {"lessons":["I should avoid treating each stock as a separate account and selling just because it is above my average cost; decisions should reflect the whole portfolio and future prospects.","Because prices move randomly, recent gains or losses alone do not reliably predict what comes next, so I should not overreact to short-term changes.","My limited trading has helped me avoid unnecessary activity; I should continue to trade infrequently and make deliberate decisions rather than react to every price move."]}
